name: Cline
summary: An open-source VS Code agent that plans, runs terminal commands and asks before each file edit.
description:
Cline runs inside VS Code as an extension, which is the whole argument: no new editor, no fork to maintain, and the model is whatever you bring, including local endpoints. It works in a plan-then-act loop with an explicit approval step per file change and per command, so a runaway agent is a thing you decided to allow rather than something that happened to you.

That step-by-step consent is also the friction: a long task is a sequence of clicks, and people who want fire-and-forget agents find it tiring. Being open source and vendor-neutral means the quality you get is the quality of the model you pay for separately.
